full_prompt_en: The image is a square close-up painting of a highly stylized face turning toward the right. The crop cuts off the forehead, chin, and much of the opposite side, so one large eye and the intricate cheek design dominate. A sweeping black eyebrow arches above a half-lidded dark eye. Bands of ocher, rust red, cream, olive-gray, and black surround the eye and continue down the face as bold curved fields. A large circular spiral sits on the cheek, enclosed by pale and golden rings. The nose becomes a long sharp triangular shape projecting to the right. A narrow dark moustache curls outward beside the compressed red-brown lips, and a rounded black beard or chin mass fills the lower right. At the far left, a large ear with a circular earring stands against dark hair and a reddish neck. The background is pale cream and mostly empty, letting the profile contour and colored planes carry the image. Color is flat in broad regions but not mechanically perfect; subtle brushed transitions and slight surface grain remain visible. Dark outlines are thick and confident, particularly around the eye, cheek spiral, mouth, and edge of the nose. The composition is strongly asymmetric, with dense facial geometry on the left and open light ground at right. There is no naturalistic light source or cast shadow; form is constructed by nested colored shapes, overlap, and crisp contour. The expression feels watchful and enigmatic. The painting's impact comes from the large eye, emphatic spiral, warm-earth palette, and the decorative compression of familiar facial features into an almost masklike design.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形近脸绘画，一张高度风格化的脸朝右转。裁切去掉额、下巴和对面大部分，因此一只大眼与繁复脸颊设计占主导。横扫的黑眉弓在半睁的深眼上。赭、锈红、奶油、橄榄灰与黑色带围住眼，并以大胆曲面继续向下。脸颊有一只大圆螺旋，被浅色和金色环包围。鼻变成向右伸的长尖三角形。细深色胡须在压缩的红褐嘴旁向外卷，圆黑胡子或下巴体块填满右下。最左侧，带圆耳环的大耳朵立在深发和红褐颈前。背景浅奶油色且大多空白，让侧脸轮廓和彩色平面承担画面。大块颜色平涂但并非机械完美；细微刷痕过渡和轻表面颗粒仍可见。深轮廓粗而笃定，尤其在眼、脸颊螺旋、嘴和鼻边。构图强烈不对称，左侧面部几何密集，右侧留开放浅底。没有自然主义光源或投影；形体由嵌套色形、重叠和清脆轮廓构造。表情警觉而难解。大眼、强调螺旋、暖地色配色与把熟悉五官装饰性压成近似面具的设计，构成画作冲击力。
style_prompt_en: Flat decorative painting transforms recognizable contours into nested bands, spirals, sharp wedges, and confident dark outlines. Warm earth red, ocher, cream, olive-gray, and black form large clean areas with slight brushed grain. A single enlarged focal shape can dominate while secondary curves repeat its rhythm. Asymmetric cropping presses dense geometry against open pale ground. Volume is symbolic and planar, created by colored layers rather than naturalistic shadow. Curving lines meet abrupt angles without losing clarity. The effect is bold, enigmatic, and handcrafted, with a masklike compression of organic form into strongly designed ornament.
style_prompt_zh: 平面装饰绘画把可辨轮廓转化为嵌套色带、螺旋、尖楔和笃定深轮廓。暖土红、赭、奶油、橄榄灰与黑组成大片清楚区域，内部有轻微刷痕颗粒。一个放大焦点形可占主导，次级曲线重复其节奏。不对称裁切把密集几何压向开放浅底。体积是象征性的平面，由色层而非自然主义阴影生成。曲线遇到突兀棱角，仍保持清楚。效果大胆、难解且有手工感，把有机形体如面具般压缩成强设计纹饰。
theme_en: A stylized close face with sweeping eyebrow, spiral cheek, and long angular nose
theme_zh: 一张风格化近脸，具有横扫的眉、旋涡脸颊与长棱角鼻
name: Kalighat painting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
